decider: Planning Director (or designee), after TAC review; may refer to Planning Commission

public_notice.cite: UDO Art. IV § 1.6.1(A): regular-mail notice to adjacent owners after TAC review, 10-day comment; no sign, no newspaper, no PC agenda

cumulative_cap.counted_from: original tract: all lots recorded since 1969-12-23 plus the remainder count toward the 7; density counted from 1989-08-01 outside the Critical Area and 1985-12-01 inside

perc_season.months: Feb-Apr (wet-season testing where high water table soils)
perc_season.cite: 01. Maryland/00. Summary.md § 1 (COMAR 26.04.02.04B); no Kent-specific rule found

county_fees.cite: Documents/Fees/Planning Health Dept Fees - September 1 2024 pp.1-2: $90 + $50/lot; stormwater formal plan $1,800; Env. Health subdivision $75 (alignment unconfirmed)

forest_conservation.cite: UDO Art. VI §§ 3.2, 3.4, 3.8 (disturbance over 40,000 sf, outside Critical Area; 50 cents/sf outside a PFA, 40 cents inside; State 1:1 rule effective 1 Jul 2026 per 01. Maryland summary may change this)

studies_required: perc/soils testing and well/sewage area layout
forest stand delineation and forest conservation plan
Critical Area report and lot coverage (if in Critical Area)
subdivision history and yield calculation to 1969
cost-of-services analysis and citizen participation plan

access.cite: UDO Art. II § 2.3 (AZD: 75 ft min lot width; max 2 lots on an existing public road, fn 3); Art. IV §§ 2.7.20, 2.7.25 (private road only in minors, max 7 parcels, 50-ft ROW); no flag-lot or shared-driveway rule found

off_ramps: 8 or more lots (major, 3-stage PC, posting and mailed notice)
density exceeded (AZD 1 per 30 ac; RCD/RC 1 per 20 ac)
third road-front lot in AZD (PC waiver or private road)
private road serving more than 7 parcels
variance or special exception (Board of Appeals, advertised)
Critical Area growth allocation or Commission objection
failed perc or no reserve area
30-day appeal of Director decision to Board of Appeals
